page_title: JUV 1-0 ROM | Juventus v AS Roma 30/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Daniele Rugani (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Weston McKennie.
90+5' Some great controlled play and passing from AS Roma. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90+3' A brilliant cross into the box finds Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
90+2' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Simone Sozza saw the whole situation.
88' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) has a goal ruled out for offside!
86' Some patient build-up play from AS Roma as they look to unlock the defence.

84' Weston McKennie (Juventus) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Rui Patricio blocks the shot with his legs.
83' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
82' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
81' Weston McKennie (Juventus) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
80' Here is a change. Nicola Zalewski is going off and Jose Mourinho gives the last tactical orders to Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma).
79' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
77' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
76' The game has come to an end for Filip Kostic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus).
76' Here comes a substitution. Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) is brought on as a substitute for Dusan Vlahovic.
74' Jose Mourinho prepares a substitution. Leandro Paredes is replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
73' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

71' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Wojciech Szczesny has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
68' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
68' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
66' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Federico Chiesa (Juventus) replacing Kenan Yildiz.
65' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Edoardo Bove leaves the pitch and Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) comes on.
62' Juventus will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
59' Timothy Weah (Juventus) trips an opposition player and Simone Sozza signals a foul.
55' Weston McKennie (Juventus) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Rui Patricio, who smothers the ball.
55' Some neat passing and movement from Juventus as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

51' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick and attempts to score with a header. His effort is not accurate at all and goes well wide of the right post.
47' 1 - 0 Goal! Dusan Vlahovic shows great vision to find Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
46' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
46' Simone Sozza blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) jumps into a tackle and Simone Sozza signals a foul.
43' Filip Kostic (Juventus) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
41' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Rui Patricio is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
40' Filip Kostic (Juventus) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
39' Juventus keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
37' Juventus are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
36' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sends a long ball in, but Wojciech Szczesny comfortably gathers the ball.
35' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
33' The ball possession at the moment is 47:53.
31' Golden opportunity! Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
29' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
28' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
27' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) and Nicola Zalewski perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
24' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
20' Filip Kostic (Juventus) launches a cross from the corner, but Rui Patricio is alert to thwart the effort.
19' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
17' A spell of possession for Juventus in an attempt to control the game.
14' Simone Sozza blows the whistle, Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) is penalised for a foul.
12' A brilliant individual effort! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post.
10' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
9' Timothy Weah (Juventus) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
8' Simone Sozza has a clear sight and sees a foul from Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma).
5' The resulting corner from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is cleared by the defence.
5' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the right post and wastes a promising chance!
4' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
3' Filip Kostic (Juventus) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
